title: Work Unit state machine
description: States persisted in events.jsonl (as 'transition' events) go up to AWAITING_HITL; MERGED/CLOSED/CLEANED are always derived from git/GitHub state, never written as events (a Work Unit cannot close itself). Exception states are reachable from any persisted state.

derivedStates.description: Never persisted as a transition event; computed from git/GitHub at read time.
